newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Sept overdue loan ratio rises to 3.89 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Sept overdue loan ratio rises to 3.89 pct.

text.p: Taiwan banks' overdue loans accounted for 3.89 percent of their total loans at the end of September, up from 3.47 percent at the end of June and 3.36 percent at the end of March, the central bank said.
Loans granted by Taiwanese banks totalled T$9,299.3 billion at the end of September, the central bank said in a statement issued on Sunday.
The bank announces the figures on a quarterly basis.

A slowing domestic economy and strong business competition in overseas markets have made local enterprises' operating environment difficult, triggering a higher percentage of overdue loans, the statement said. ($1 = T$27.5) -- Taipei Newsroom (2-5080815)
